_comment: truvio-demo 1.8.0 SqlTable predicates, Serializer 1.0.1-beta config schema (docs/configuration.md SqlTable predicate fields). Intended home: layers/truvio-demo/config/truvio-demo-2.4.json, which Compose-Edition unions into the composed Serializer.config.json (Compose-Edition.ps1:731-741, keyed mode|name). Every predicate is Merge: the layer is kind sample-data and ships only its own TC* rows. Order is FK-safe (parents first) and is also the harvest order; the engine re-sorts SqlTable entries by sys.foreign_keys at deserialize (SerializerOrchestrator.cs:405-429) and disables constraints per table while writing (SqlTableWriter.cs:407). Underscore keys are annotations: ConfigLoader uses default System.Text.Json options (ConfigLoader.cs:18) and ignores them, and Compose-Edition skips top-level _* keys (Compose-Edition.ps1:723). No nameColumn anywhere: file names come from the PK joined with $$, which keeps the base/cross-layer filename collision checks meaningful (base.contract.json:179-188). No serviceCaches: none of the eighteen DwCacheServiceRegistry names is verified for these tables; the host restart the layer already requires covers the caches.

predicates.name: truvio-demo AccessUser
predicates._why: Merge: a re-deserialize must never reset a persona or the password UserSetPassword set. The identity key is written with IDENTITY_INSERT (SqlTableWriter.cs:45-64), so 100100..100103 survive. Password and runtime login columns are excluded; AccessUserPasswordSalt is deliberately absent because the column does not exist on DW 10.28.10 and a missing column fails config load.
